cases.title: A slice name without id, with an empty id or with id None raises Fail
cases.when: Call name(fmt, "slice") with no id, with id="" and with id=None
cases.then: Each call raises Fail, never another exception and never a return value, and prints nothing
cases.expected: Fail for each of the 6 calls
cases.actual: Fail for each of the 6 calls: a slice branch name needs a non-empty id
cases.specSource: spec section 2 tail: a missing part is a Fail; ADR-20261009-034220

cases.title: A non-string id is converted by str: the result is recorded
cases.given: The format sdlc/{name} and the kind slice
cases.when: Call name with id 7, 0, -1, 1.5, False, True, [], ['S-1'], {}, a space, a tab, 'S 001', '..' and 'S-001.lock'
cases.then: Record each result. The spec states no type or content rule for id, so only id=7 -> sdlc/7 is asserted
cases.actual: 7 -> sdlc/7; 0 -> sdlc/0; False -> sdlc/False; [] -> sdlc/[]; {} -> sdlc/{}; ' ' -> 'sdlc/ '; '..' -> sdlc/..; every call returns, none raises Fail
cases.specSource: verification plan VS-7 notes: report the result

cases.title: An unhashable kind gives TypeError, not Fail: the result is recorded
cases.given: The format sdlc/{name} and id S-001
cases.when: Call name with the kinds [], ['slice'], {} and {slice: 1}
cases.then: Record the outcome. The spec defines kind as one of the named kinds, so a list or a dict is a type misuse with no stated error
cases.actual: TypeError: cannot use 'list' as a dict key (unhashable type: 'list'); the same for dict

cases.title: The same missing-part call gives the same outcome every time
cases.when: Call it three times in one process
cases.then: The outcome, type and message are equal each time

seeds.title: name accepts a non-string id and stringifies it
seeds.detail: name("sdlc/{name}", "slice", id=False) gives sdlc/False, id=[] gives sdlc/[] and id={} gives sdlc/{}. tail checks only None and the empty string. A type check on parts, or a Fail for a non-str id, keeps such names out of git.

seeds.title: name does not check the id text against git
seeds.detail: name gives sdlc/.., 'sdlc/ ' and sdlc/S-001.lock without Fail. validate_format checks only the sample id S-001. A caller that passes an operator id gets a name that git check-ref-format refuses later.

seeds.title: an unhashable kind raises TypeError, not Fail
seeds.detail: tail uses TAILS.get(kind), so a list or a dict kind raises TypeError. Every other unknown kind raises Fail. An isinstance check on kind makes the Fail contract total.

seeds.title: testkit: pycall cannot pass keyword arguments
seeds.detail: callPython calls fn(*args) only. name and tail take **parts, so the verifier wrote a shim module with name_kw(fmt, kind, parts). A kwargs field in the pycall request removes the shim.
